setDevice installs the same connection on its new nonnull device after resetting stream status/state.
QObject::connect normalizes raw type3 to0 (r13d was zeroed at0x671315ee).
Private constructor installs embedded receiver vtable0x6722c288 at private+8.

aboutToClose signal tail-calls QObject activation0x6712ec70 with QIODevice metaobject0x67256428 and local signal2.

Activation compares receiver thread id with current id; normalized type0 uses queued branch only when different, otherwise direct path0x6712f108. Relevant local QFile/receiver construction is same-thread.
~QTextStream checks pending write buffer length and calls flushWriteBuffer before private destruction when nonempty.

Private reset called by external-device constructor clears ownership byte+0x20; external QFile is not deleted by Stream destruction.

QIODevice aboutToClose while device still open; Stream flushes pending text through its existing sticky-status guard.
QIODevice clears openMode; QFile clears residual byte buffer and closes its native engine.

superseded_assumption.text: Unflushed QTextStream text is lost merely because the writer calls QFile.close before QTextStream destruction.
superseded_assumption.disposition: Wrong for the recovered same-thread QFile/QTextStream connection; pending successful-close text is flushed by aboutToClose. Earlier comments/receipts expressing that assumption are superseded by this receipt.
superseded_assumption.preserve: Status3 still suppresses pending text during close notification/destructor. QFile can independently retry a byte-buffered earlier line.
